name: temporal_query
description: Query the v3.3 temporal read model for current, historical, or as_of confirmed truth. Returns valid/recorded time, provenance, supersede chain, timeline, explanations, and abstention metadata. Read-only: rebuilds the projection from confirmed truth and never mutates memory.

query.description: Optional substring query over subject, predicate, and object

subject.description: Optional subject filter. Relation facts use source_entity; rules use trigger; memory entries use category.

predicate.description: Optional predicate filter. Relation facts use relation_type.

mode.description: current=currently valid, history=expired truth, as_of=valid at the supplied timestamp.

as_of.description: ISO datetime for valid-time lookup. Used with mode=as_of; also honored when supplied directly.

valid_from.description: ISO datetime lower bound for valid-time overlap filter.

valid_to.description: ISO datetime upper bound for valid-time overlap filter.

recorded_from.description: ISO datetime lower bound for recorded_at filter.

recorded_to.description: ISO datetime upper bound for recorded_at filter.

limit.description: Maximum records to return (default 20, hard cap 100).

require_unique_current.description: When true, multiple current records in current mode produce temporal_conflict abstention.
